item.title: [New] Intune Data Warehouse policy-status collections move to the new reporting infrastructure from 4 January 2027; counts may change
item.description:
Compliance dashboards built on Data Warehouse can show a step change in compliant or failing device counts that is a reporting change, not a security event.

Intune · Note the date in any compliance or Conditional Access readiness report built on these collections so a jump in counts after 4 January is not chased as an incident.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Intune updates the iOS/iPadOS web-based device enrollment experience in late January 2027, ahead of it becoming the default
item.description:
Helpdesk and user guidance for BYOD enrollment changes; enrollment is the gate for device-compliance Conditional Access, so confusing screens drive support calls.

Intune · Update BYOD enrollment guidance and helpdesk scripts before late January 2027; no configuration change.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Message Center] MC1565960 Plan for Change: Updates to policy-related reporting in Microsoft Intune Data Warehouse
item.description:
Starting January 4, 2027, Microsoft Intune Data Warehouse will update policy-related reporting collections, possibly causing changes in policy-status counts. Existing connections and schemas remain unchanged, and no action is required. Differences from Intune admin center reports may occur due to timing and aggregation.

Microsoft Intune · planForChange

item.title: [Message Center] MC1565959 Plan for Change: Updated web-based device enrollment experience for iOS/iPadOS
item.description:
Microsoft Intune will update the web-based device enrollment experience for iOS/iPadOS in late January 2027, affecting only tenants using this method. No admin action is needed, but user guidance may be updated. This change precedes web-based enrollment becoming the default for iOS/iPadOS.
